mentions.claim_text: He says Canada is involved but the darkness is only over Toronto, and that looking over Buckingham, England, France and Germany it is with the leaders and they are planning.
mentions.quote: the darkness is not it's only over Toronto
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated European leadership initiative with Canadian involvement.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a financial storm in New York and says the same blackness that is on Europe is on America's financial buildings at Times Square.
mentions.quote: The same black that is on Europe is on America's financial buildings
mentions.falsify_match: A financial crisis hitting Europe and America together.

mentions.claim_text: He names JP Morgan, BlackRock, Bank of America and Wells Fargo, and describes the image as the black and white of a mime's painted face with a black hat.
mentions.quote: I see JP Morgan. I see a BlackRock. I see Bank of America
mentions.falsify_match: Trouble at those four named institutions.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The same four are named across several separate bank claims in this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He describes Asian women in Europe and Asia dressed like porcelain dolls with black hair, long flowered dresses and painted faces.
mentions.quote: I see Asian women dressed up like porcelain dolls
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; no reading is offered.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats war several times and says he sees the Nazi flag and the swastika as a Batman symbol and a bat signal over Europe, and that there is a very dark plan.
mentions.quote: I see the swastika as a Batman symbol over Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A far right resurgence across Europe leading to war.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be great distractions in America from shore to shore, that they will try to distract and manipulate with fear.
mentions.quote: They'll try to manipulate you with fear
mentions.falsify_match: A run of major news stories later shown to be diversions.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can fail here; any news cycle satisfies it.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are trying to summon a demonic spirit with Hitler and that it is the war, and compares it to flashes of light racing across the night skies.
mentions.quote: they're trying to summon this demonic spirit with a Hitler
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim is about a summoned spirit.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says Turkey will come to Russia's aid and close it off, recalls telling them the leader comes like a vampire, and his wife supplies the name of the strait.
mentions.quote: I see Turkey coming to the aid of Russia and they're closing off that
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey closes the strait in Russia's favour.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The name of the waterway is supplied by his wife rather than by the vision.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what the basis of the song is, hears the whatever will be will be line again when he gets quiet, and reads it as a rebellion or a do not care attitude over Europe.
mentions.quote: Is a rebellion like a I don't care attitude
mentions.falsify_match: European fatalism becomes a recognised political mood.

mentions.claim_text: He describes darkened pews with light coming into the church, cobwebs and tumbleweeds outside and sage grass growing up the sides of the buildings.
mentions.quote: the pews are darkened with darkness inside of the pews
mentions.falsify_match: Emptied churches filling again.

mentions.claim_text: He says the bells and steeple were darkened but the glory of the Lord is shining on the bells as they ring across the land, the church is becoming alive and a shaking to a waking is coming.
mentions.quote: I hear the church bells ringing across the land
mentions.falsify_match: A European church revival.

mentions.claim_text: He says Europe has no freedom of religion and that the Lord will shake that mentality, is shaking the Catholic Church and the Protestants, that they are running out of time and that they will see a great revival.
mentions.quote: I'm shaking the Catholic Church, the Protestants
mentions.falsify_match: Upheaval in European denominations followed by growth.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the time and that they have been going three hours, and repeats that the church bells are ringing and asks whether they are listening to the heartbeat of the father.
mentions.quote: The church bells are ringing, ladies and gentlemen
mentions.falsify_match: A church revival follows.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is at Epcot in the spirit seeing the American pavilion, asks anyone who has been there to picture it, and says it is about the two hundred and fifty years.
mentions.quote: I'm at Epcot and I see American Epcot. It's the 250 years
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to an identifiable event.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; no reading is offered beyond the number.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Mount of Olives is going to have a major earthquake and that it is symbolic of America, a shaking in America whose heart is Israel and Jerusalem.
mentions.quote: The Mount of Olives is going to have a major earthquake
mentions.falsify_match: An earthquake at the Mount of Olives.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He also calls it symbolic of America, which allows a non-physical reading.

mentions.claim_text: He says he cannot let it go, that he sees such a shaking and something major about to take place like a first domino, and that it has to do with America.
mentions.quote: It's like a first domino. It's to do with America
mentions.falsify_match: A single national event that sets off a chain.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. No event, place or date is given.

mentions.claim_text: He says Jesus Christ is coming and it can be seen by those with eyes to see and ears to hear, and that it is exciting.
mentions.quote: Jesus Christ is coming. And you can see it
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a general statement of expectation.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no date is given.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the president went to a New York game and was booed by a crowd he calls crazy, says they are praying for his safety on the way out, and that the Lord already said nothing would happen.
mentions.quote: the Lord said nothing would happen already
mentions.falsify_match: The visit passes without incident.
mentions.falsify_miss: An incident occurs. A claim that nothing will happen is the safest form of prediction available.

mentions.claim_text: He says the earthquake shook Florida, Miami and Tampa, notes a named minister lives in the Tampa area, and that it registered on the charts clear up into Alaska.
mentions.quote: it went on the charts clear up into Alaska
mentions.falsify_match: A Caribbean earthquake felt across Florida.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reading is a seismograph trace rather than felt shaking. Distant instruments record every large quake, which is not the same as it shaking Alaska.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is a God of signs, that Cuba is about to be liberated and have a major revival, and that it is amazing this happened right outside it, recalling that he saw thousand year old temples falling.
mentions.quote: Cuba is about to be liberated. Cuba is about to have a major revival
mentions.falsify_match: Cuba is liberated and a revival follows.

mentions.claim_text: He says a major shaking to awaken is coming to Cuba, that the signs in the earth mean the earth is in travail with labour pains, and that it is rocking and reeling like a drunkard.
mentions.quote: A major shaking to awaken is coming to Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: A damaging Cuban earthquake followed by religious change.

mentions.claim_text: He lists shakings in the Philippines and a 5.2 in Greece, says they know what the Lord said about Italy, and that seeing it right outside Cuba that day is not coincidence.
mentions.quote: that's not coincidence
mentions.falsify_match: An unusual global cluster of large earthquakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ordinary daily seismicity. A 5.2 in Greece is routine; Greece records several a year.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has seen both sides praying for peace with the lavender, the people of Russia and Ukraine praying, and then saw a world war above it with Apollyon.
mentions.quote: I've seen both sides praying for peace with the lavender
mentions.falsify_match: A negotiated peace, or a wider war.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. He holds both outcomes at once, which is why it cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says something was right over Putin influencing him, and that the previous night he felt an urgency to pray rather than being bothered.
mentions.quote: I felt an urgency to pray
mentions.falsify_match: An event follows the stated urgency.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls hearing I am not going to abandon you and that a great betrayal was coming, and says he would not have thought it was with the president, but that they heard it would be called a great betrayal.
mentions.quote: I would not think it was with Trump
mentions.falsify_match: A rupture publicly described as a betrayal.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He is revising who the betrayer is after the fact.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was praying for named pastors who are on an Israel tour with a group and are looking at everything and having a good time.
mentions.quote: they're taking an Israel tour
mentions.falsify_match: Something befalls the group.

mentions.claim_text: He looks at footage of Iranian forces and the Houthis, remarks that it is all dark and hard to tell what it shows.
mentions.quote: Well, you can't tell. It's all dark
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; he cannot make out the footage.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said this will be worse, that he saw it happen in the night, and that he believes something major is about to happen, then turns to China going to North Korea for the first time in seven years.
mentions.quote: The Lord said this will be worse. I saw it happen in the night
mentions.falsify_match: A night attack worse than the previous one.

mentions.claim_text: He plays an official saying counter drone measures will cover all seventy eight World Cup matches and every fan fest, described as seventy eight Super Bowls for security and counter drone purposes.
mentions.quote: All 78 matches including a fan fest in every single city
mentions.falsify_match: A drone incident at a World Cup venue.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord warned them to pray for this event and for the subways, that it is not about the building itself but the extremities outside it, naming Boston and other areas.
mentions.quote: It's not about the building, per se
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on transport infrastructure around a major venue.

mentions.claim_text: He calls it a red dawn experience and a major disruption, and says he was praying over Hawaii again, over a luxury store and the mall and three men in the mall.
mentions.quote: Praying over the mall. Three men in the mall
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at a Hawaiian shopping mall.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw major churches, Catholic buildings and old buildings on fire from Toronto to British Columbia and in America, a poking of the giant, and that it was Muslim people burning the churches.
mentions.quote: it was Muslim people that were burning the churches
mentions.falsify_match: Church arson attributed to Muslim actors at scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: Arson continues from other causes, which is what North American investigations have generally found.

mentions.claim_text: Prompted by his son, he confirms he saw people burning things in New York wearing a green shirt, and says he does not know what the green shirt represented and that it was being looked up.
mentions.quote: I don't know what the green shirt represented
mentions.falsify_match: Rioters in New York identifiable by green clothing.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appear. He says in advance that he does not know what it means.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls a vision in which they would try to hit two places at once, Israel under attack and America, and says there are secret cells of people in America.
mentions.quote: they would be tried to hit at two places at once
mentions.falsify_match: Simultaneous attacks on Israel and America.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for shaking Cuba that day, says he does not know whether anyone was injured, calls it a sign, and names signs in Malibu.
mentions.quote: I thank you, Lord, for the shaking. It's a sign
mentions.falsify_match: A damaging Cuban earthquake.
mentions.falsify_miss: A minor offshore event. He does not check the magnitude or whether anyone was hurt before calling it a sign.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have to wait for the votes to come in and then it all goes toward the Democrats, that they know what they are doing and so does the government, and that they did it to the president before.
mentions.quote: now it's all going towards Democrats. And so, we know what they're doing
mentions.falsify_match: Late-counted ballots are shown to have been manipulated.

mentions.claim_text: He says a figure has invited him to hold major Holy Ghost meetings in an arena if he wins the election, and would accommodate him in any way possible for salvations, healings and miracles in Colombia.
mentions.quote: he's invited me to hold major Holy Ghost meetings in an arena there
mentions.falsify_match: The election is won and the meetings take place.
mentions.falsify_miss: He loses, or the meetings do not happen.

mentions.claim_text: He says many hands make light work, that they prayed for those souls, salvations, healings and manifestations of glory, and that this is just the beginning.
mentions.quote: I'm expecting that this is just the beginning
mentions.falsify_match: Larger meetings follow.

mentions.claim_text: Watching footage of people lying down a street as far as can be seen, he says his family were rejoicing and were part of praying it in, and that the audience should be excited too.
mentions.quote: They're lying down the street
mentions.falsify_match: Mass meetings of that scale continue.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was told he is thinking too small and to look big, and recalls the make no little plans motto in an auditorium and a founder who had big on the inside of him, with the building and the medical centre.
mentions.quote: You're thinking too little. Look it big
mentions.falsify_match: The ministry expands at the scale implied.

mentions.claim_text: Shown a volcano erupting in Japan, he says they know what the Lord warned about Japanese volcanoes and that a massive one will explode and it is Mount Fuji, with a lot of people affected when it happens.
mentions.quote: There'll be a massive one explode and it's Mount Fuji
mentions.falsify_match: Mount Fuji erupts.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Japan has roughly 111 active volcanoes and eruptions elsewhere do not settle a Fuji claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said they are about to see signs in the heavens, in the earth and all over, that it is happening as birthing pains, and notes a Russian volcano erupting that day.
mentions.quote: we're about to see signs in the heavens, signs in the earth
mentions.falsify_match: An unusual cluster of eruptions and celestial events.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ordinary volcanic activity. Around fifty volcanoes are erupting worldwide at any time.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether this is it, says he saw a darkness, and notes an 8.6 earthquake in the Philippines, praying protection over the people there.
mentions.quote: a big 8.6 earthquake in the Philippines
mentions.falsify_match: An 8.6 in the Philippines is confirmed.
mentions.falsify_miss: The magnitude is revised down. He asks whether this is it rather than asserting it, which is the right form.

mentions.claim_text: He says volcanoes are going off, that they gave the word the previous week, and that the Lord said shakings in all areas, with the Vatican about to shake, the Temple Mount about to shake and Malibu shaking.
mentions.quote: Vatican's about to shake. The temple mount's about to shake
mentions.falsify_match: Earthquakes at Rome, Jerusalem and Malibu.

mentions.claim_text: He identifies a turtle in glasses from an earlier vision as Germany, recalled alongside doves and black crows trying to tear out the heart of the dove.
mentions.quote: There's the turtle. Who is that? That's Germany
mentions.falsify_match: German behaviour matches what the turtle represented.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The identification is made now rather than when the vision was given.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a French phrase he says means united for Ukraine, he says they want to poke the bear, that he saw the French president leading the charge and talking to big bankers.
mentions.quote: They want to poke the bear
mentions.falsify_match: France leads a European escalation over Ukraine.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were bringing forth Hitler's spirit over the nations to bring a world war while Europe was burning, that it has portals, and that he watched them doing satanic things at CERN to bring things out of portals with the Nephilim.
mentions.quote: they were doing satanic things to bring forth things out of portals
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim concerns portals and spirits.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was in a meeting in the spirit when the Lord told him to listen closely, and heard Satan and big bankers planning to bring war.
mentions.quote: the Lord said, Listen, listen closely
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; a spiritual meeting.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a British politician saying they are reasonable and tolerant, react calmly to a named case, and take on and fight a named AI platform over disgusting images because that is who they are as a country.
mentions.quote: we take Grok on and fight because that's who we are
mentions.falsify_match: British legal action against the platform.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them Europe would sue and there would be big lawsuits against Elon Musk in the days ahead, and notes a Marilyn Monroe candle visible behind the speaker.
mentions.quote: Europe will sue him and there'll be big lawsuits in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Major European legal actions against Musk.

mentions.claim_text: He works through the national debt arithmetic, saying that spending a million a day since Jesus was born would total less than two per cent of it, and that this is why he said America is in financial trouble.
mentions.quote: you would have only spent $740 billion, less than 2% of our national debt
mentions.falsify_match: An American debt crisis.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The arithmetic is a rhetorical device rather than a forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He says the beast system and a one world order are coming, and asks how that can happen with the dollar in play at thirty six to nearly forty trillion in debt.
mentions.quote: The beast system is coming. A one world order is coming
mentions.falsify_match: The dollar is displaced by a global system.

mentions.claim_text: He describes hitting a wall in prayer where tongues feel insufficient for what he is seeing, and says he is looking into Israel because his pastors are there.
mentions.quote: your tongues isn't sufficient enough for what you're seeing
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a description of his own experience.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He sees fires and buildings burning in New York with rioting, and says there is a planned staged event coming in New York similar to but on a greater scale than the 2020 unrest.
mentions.quote: there's a planned staged event in New York coming
mentions.falsify_match: Rioting in New York exceeding the 2020 scale.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees New York burning, that it is all races, that he sees green, and prays over the New York basketball games.
mentions.quote: I see New York burning. It's all races. I see green
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread rioting in New York marked by green.
